intro:
A game to learn about the Blue Ticket system
Two gameplay modes: Quiz and Action
Simultaneous Japanese and English display
description:
A game that teaches you about Japan's "Blue Ticket" system!

This game allows you to learn about Japanese traffic laws and the "Traffic Infringement Notification System" (commonly known as the "Blue Ticket" system)—which came into effect in April 2026—through gameplay. In the quiz stage, you can learn the correct rules and interesting trivia via True/False questions. The action stage lets you navigate a city modeled after real Japanese streets, challenging you to reach your destination safely without committing any traffic violations.

Is it okay to ride on the sidewalk? What is the correct way to navigate a T-junction? Can children get a "Blue Ticket"? Is it permissible to hang bags on the handlebars? Find the answers to these questions and more.
Use this game to acquire accurate and proper knowledge.

The game features a bilingual display (Japanese and English), making it a great tool for language study.
It is also designed so that international visitors to Japan—or anyone interested in understanding Japanese traffic laws—can play with ease and confidence.
